Potential harm: Agent could read or modify unauthorized HR records
Control: Scope tokens, role-based access and denied-call tests
Trusted instruction boundary, tool authorization, adversarial testing

Potential harm: Agent transmits candidate PII outside approved systems
Control: Data controls, destination allow-list, DLP and privacy review
Human gate; no rejection-capable agent tool
Identity verification, mTLS/signed messages where applicable

Potential harm: API keys leaked in generated output or logs
Control: Secrets vault, masking, rotation and anomaly detection

Potential harm: Agent makes plausible sequence with bad outcome
Control: Step limits, intermediate validation, transaction previews

Potential harm: Recursion leads to excessive cost, requests or changes
Control: Step count, budget, retry and timeout limits
Fairness checks, job-relevant rubric, human decision

Potential harm: Agent invents HR policy and acts on it

Control: Session separation, retention rules, deletion verification
Supplier assessment, version lock, connector review

Potential harm: Cannot reconstruct who authorized an action
Control: Structured tamper-evident event logs with redaction
Out-of-band kill switch and token revocation drill
